_comment: Branch protection ruleset for the main branch. Applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh. STAGED DEPLOYMENT: this file is the target state but is NOT applied until its prerequisites land (see T17/T18 in LS-3857 epic).
name: main-branch-protection

rules._comment: Prevent force pushes to main — history must be linear and immutable.
Prevent direct deletion of the main branch.

Require a pull request before merging into main. STAGED: require_code_owner_review=true is the target state once CODEOWNERS has a catch-all reviewer entry (pending T3 service-account provisioning). Until that lands, the bot's approval satisfies required_approving_review_count=1 independently of CODEOWNERS. Apply this ruleset only after CODEOWNERS is complete.

STAGED DEPLOYMENT — DO NOT APPLY until prerequisites are met (design §3.7 two-step deploy): (1) ci-pipeline.yml is refactored to emit granular per-stage job names below, AND (2) those jobs are confirmed passing on several PRs. The contexts below are the TARGET names per design §9.1; they replace the current Quality Gates / Build Validation rollups. Applying before the CI refactor creates stuck 'Expected' required checks.
